title: "4. Metagenomics quiz"
format: html

**Question 1: What gene is commonly targeted for bacterial community profiling?**

::: {=html}
<form id="q1">
  <input type="radio" name="q1" value="a"> A. COI<br>
  <input type="radio" name="q1" value="b"> B. 18S rRNA<br>
  <input type="radio" name="q1" value="c"> C. 16S rRNA<br>
  <input type="radio" name="q1" value="d"> D. ITS<br><br>
  <button type="button" onclick="checkAnswer('q1','c')">Submit</button>
</form>
<div id="result-q1" style="margin-top:1em;font-weight:bold;"></div>
:::


**Question 2: Which sequencing approach provides the highest functional resolution?**

::: {=html}
<form id="q2">
  <input type="radio" name="q2" value="a"> A. Short-read 16S rRNA sequencing<br>
  <input type="radio" name="q2" value="b"> B. Long-read 16S rRNA sequencing<br>
  <input type="radio" name="q2" value="c"> C. Shotgun metagenomic sequencing<br>
  <input type="radio" name="q2" value="d"> D. Amplicon-based metatranscriptomics<br><br>
  <button type="button" onclick="checkAnswer('q2','c')">Submit</button>
</form>
<div id="result-q2" style="margin-top:1em;font-weight:bold;"></div>
:::


**Question 3: What is a key advantage of long-read 16S rRNA sequencing compared to short-read 16S?**

::: {=html}
<form id="q3">
  <input type="radio" name="q3" value="a"> A. Lower cost per base<br>
  <input type="radio" name="q3" value="b"> B. Higher taxonomic resolution across the full 16S gene<br>
  <input type="radio" name="q3" value="c"> C. Faster sequencing speed<br>
  <input type="radio" name="q3" value="d"> D. Detects RNA viruses<br><br>
  <button type="button" onclick="checkAnswer('q3','b')">Submit</button>
</form>
<div id="result-q3" style="margin-top:1em;font-weight:bold;"></div>
:::


**Question 4: I took you through a couple of papers in *Medfly* that have used long-read sequencing. What’s the main issue with these studies?**

::: {=html}
<form id="q4">
  <input type="radio" name="q4" value="a"> A. The sequencing depth was too high, leading to data redundancy.<br>
  <input type="radio" name="q4" value="b"> B. Despite using long reads, the taxonomic classifiers couldn’t resolve taxa beyond the genus level.<br>
  <input type="radio" name="q4" value="c"> C. Long reads introduced large sequencing errors that prevented assembly.<br>
  <input type="radio" name="q4" value="d"> D. The studies focused only on viral DNA rather than bacterial communities.<br><br>
  <button type="button" onclick="checkAnswer('q4','b')">Submit</button>
</form>
<div id="result-q4" style="margin-top:1em;font-weight:bold;"></div>
:::


<div id="score" style="margin-top:2em; font-weight:bold; font-size:1.2em;"></div>

```{=html}
<script>
let score = 0;
let total = 4; // total number of questions
let answered = {}; // track which questions have been answered to avoid double scoring

function checkAnswer(id, correct) {
  const answer = document.querySelector(`#${id} input[type='radio']:checked`);
  const result = document.getElementById(`result-${id}`);

  if (!answer) {
    result.textContent = "⚠️ Please select an answer.";
    result.style.color = "orange";
    return;
  }

  if (answered[id]) {
    result.textContent = "ℹ️ You’ve already answered this question.";
    result.style.color = "gray";
    return;
  }

  if (answer.value === correct) {
    result.textContent = "Correct!";
    result.style.color = "green";
    score++;
  } else {
    result.textContent = "Incorrect.";
    result.style.color = "red";
  }

  answered[id] = true;
  document.getElementById("score").textContent = `Current Score: ${score}/${total}`;
}
</script>
